componentContractValidation.mode: Known attributes and projected dataForm value constraints; not full editor or runtime behavior
componentContractValidation.localReferences: Identical repeated editor anchors are coalesced into local definitions; conflicting or unresolved anchors fail
componentContractValidation.slotHandling: Editor type=slot is not JSON Schema; slot names are checked against CALS child items
excludedMetadata: x-* including x-rules and platform rules
editor default values, labels, descriptions and widgets
format annotations; no format validator is installed
Empty editor enum[] choices are unavailable; declared types are validated but choice membership is not
limitations: Top-level omitted props rely on documented runtime defaults; no defaults are injected
CSS syntax and selected visible-state rules are checked, not full computed style
Rendering, interaction, menu navigation and backend authorization require runtime verification

visualAndRuntimeVerification: Recorded separately; static checks do not prove rendered appearance
